pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 17
   C. 72
   D. 1

2. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 33
   C. 32
   D. 12

3. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.6
   C. 33
   D. 27.7

4. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 10
   C. 100
   D. 11

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 88
   B. 19
   C. 22
   D. 38

6. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 30
   C. 120
   D. 46

8. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 1

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 81

10. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 29
   C. 23.7
   D. 23

11. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 19.6

12. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 19
   C. 23
   D. 17

13. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

14. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

15. Solve for x: x + 7 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 7
   C. 13
   D. 7

16. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 50

17. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.7
   C. 31
   D. 31.6

18. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x > 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x = 5

19. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 22

20. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

21. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

22. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

23. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 17

24. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 24
   D. 10

25. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 13
   C. 26
   D. 170

26. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 24

27. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 1

28. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 48

29. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

30. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 56
   C. 57
   D. 15

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
